title: Simulating Social Media Using Large Language Models to Evaluate Alternative News Feed Algorithms
findings: Religion was included as a demographic attribute (e.g., 'Evangelical Protestant') in the agent personas created from the American National Election Study data. However, the paper does not report any specific findings or analyses related to the behavior of agents based on their religious affiliation. The analysis focuses on political partisanship and toxicity.
